rendering_contract.math: Math runs contain LaTeX for KaTeX or MathJax. Currency stays in text runs.
rendering_contract.solution_steps: One step per line. Never merge A/B/C/D explanations.
rendering_contract.unit_conversion: Conversions are separate paragraph or step blocks; keep them on their own line.
rendering_contract.number_lines: Horizontal only, exact rational coordinates, draw to scale. Question diagrams may not reveal solution points.
rendering_contract.tables: Render headers and rows as native tables; cells can contain text and math.
rendering_contract.solution_visibility: Show all specified methods after configured attempts or on review. Preserve number-line-only and integrated exceptions.

circled_terms.wrapping: wrap between complete terms; never split a term or its sign

division_rows.layout: Place each divisor left of a black L-shaped divider; align signed terms in columns and show each quotient row beneath.
division_rows.signs: Keep signs with terms. Multiply all left divisors for the outside factor.
division_rows.negative_factor_order: A -1 division must appear only in a separate final block, after all positive numeric/variable divisions and the positive-factor result.

rendering_contract.solution_sections: Separate the question, given quantities, terms/model, and simplification with one blank-line-sized gap; keep each given quantity on its own row.
rendering_contract.word_problem_solutions: Question, optional Variables, Numbers and Operations; inline quantities include units/meaning. Use a multiplication dot. Bold headings and answer fragments only. Finish with a contextual conclusion. Stored legacy solution methods remain as metadata; word_problem is the canonical visible solution.

grading_contract.numeric: Parse integers, decimals, fractions and mixed numbers as exact rational values. Compare the complete value; never substring-match.
grading_contract.units: Ignore attached unit text; display the expected unit outside the answer input.
reject: multiple conflicting numeric answers in one field
grading_contract.decimal_required: If required_format is decimal or repeating_decimal, reject fraction-only input. Accept a repeating-digit control or parentheses notation such as 2.8(3).
grading_contract.precision: Do not silently round. Accept exact fractions or exact repeating decimals for nonterminating results.
grading_contract.work: Only require non-whitespace content; do not grade the work.
grading_contract.time: Check day and time; midnight is 00:00, noon is 12:00.

algebraic.expected_representation: A polynomial is a list of exact rational coefficients and variable-exponent maps. Empty powers means a constant.
algebraic.comparison: Combine like terms in a bounded parser and compare exact coefficients and powers. Accept reordered equivalent simplified terms.
algebraic.required_format: Lessons 2-0 through 2-5 require expanded, combined terms; reordered terms are accepted. Lesson 2-6 uses task-appropriate factoring or equivalent-expression checks.
algebraic.factoring: For this review Lesson 2-6 uses multiple choice. Compare the chosen option to the key. All four options are independently expanded; exactly one is equivalent. Worked integer factors remove numeric content and common variables completely; decimal factors leave primitive integer coefficients inside.

fractional_coefficient_input.plain_text_convention: In an algebraic coefficient position, 1/4x is interpreted as (1/4)*x. Explicit 1/(4*x) and a structured fraction with 4x in the denominator remain reciprocal expressions.
fractional_coefficient_input.structured_fraction: A fraction with numerator1 and denominator4 followed by x is a one-fourth coefficient.

approved_five_star.scope: New IDs 236-242 only; do not reinterpret existing types or saved revisions.
approved_five_star.integer_denominator_count: Type 236 accepts the numeric number of integer denominators, not a list of those denominators.
approved_five_star.simplified_squared_expressions: Types 238 and 239 accept equivalent reordered expanded, combined polynomial terms with exact exponents, including MathLive LaTeX fractions and powers. Do not accept uncombined or still grouped expressions.
approved_five_star.complete_factoring: Type 242 requires the full greatest common numeric factor outside primitive integer coefficients. Accept positive or negative GCF and reordered primitive terms. Reject equivalent expanded expressions and unfinished factoring.
approved_five_star.work: One non-whitespace character is sufficient for short-response work; work content is not graded.

title: Grade 7 Unit 2 - Algebraic Expressions (reconstructed review bank)

source.provenance_note: Teacher identifies the 24 printed items as NY State questions from 2017-2026. Years have not been independently verified. New practice items are original, inspired by the skills; no official choices are copied.

pcl_contract.applies_only_to: Explicit simplify tasks, simplified sum-of-terms tasks, and the separately requested simplification part of a simplify-then-factor task.
pcl_contract.parentheses: Include only when the displayed expression or constructed model has grouping to remove. Omit the stage and any mention when there is none.
pcl_contract.circle: Circle EVERY expanded term with its sign in the SAME black ellipse. Include constants. No color coding or different shapes.
pcl_contract.like_terms: Reorder full matching terms; show each variable group and constants separately if needed. Never replace ax+bx by (a+b)x in the explanation. Finish with the complete simplified expression.
pcl_contract.simple_distribution: When distribution finishes the expression and leaves no like terms, show only distribution and its result.
pcl_contract.no_like_terms: All terms are unlike. Keep every term and its sign.

solution_policy.recognition: A direct explanation of the requested feature. Never simplify before counting terms.
solution_policy.evaluation: Substitute with parentheses, then follow order of operations.
solution_policy.writing_only: Question, one given per row, each modeled term with its meaning, then connect the terms with the needed operations.
solution_policy.simplification: Show only the work the question needs. Full PCL for grouping plus like terms; unnumbered Circle and Like terms when there is no grouping; distribution alone when it already gives the final expression.
solution_policy.factoring: Keep both methods. Do not show multiply-back checks. Method 2 divides by positive factors first and gives the result directly; an optional separate -1 division is last, after the positive-factor result.
solution_policy.word_problems: Identify the requested quantity; list each given on its own row with units; translate one component per row; connect components into the requested expression. Simplify only when needed.

example_policy.resolution: Use the existing next variant within this type: A to B through J to A. No separate example bank.
example_policy.assessment_note: Reserve the referenced example from the same attempt/assignment so a worked example is not later served as a graded question. Resolve this in the selector before activation.
example_policy.example_release: The application must expose only the requested example, never the complete answer bank.
example_policy.five_star_resolution: Resolve the stored next A-E variant within the same five-star type. Reserve both the graded and example IDs; at most two disjoint pairs can be selected without recycling.

selection_contract.difficulty_per_type: One fixed rating in 1-5; existing ratings are unchanged. Each lesson receives exactly one approved five-star type.
selection_contract.five_star_exception: Teacher explicitly approved one type and five A-E variants per lesson; legacy ten-variant types and existing 1-4-star coverage rules are unchanged.

required: Implement exact polynomial checks and the explicit fractional-coefficient input convention.
Implement multi-part geometry answers, native circles and division-row renderers.
Reserve worked example variants from graded selection and keep answer keys server-only.
